name: LBv2 + 60 g/L sodium formate (PMC10682008)
description: LBv2 + 60 g/L sodium formate — medium reported in PMC10682008 (complex/undefined base — extracts not BiGG-mappable).

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC10682008 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Complex medium: chemically-defined portion mapped to BiGG; biological extracts listed in `unmapped`. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.verification_evidence: grown in the LBv2 medium containing approximately 60 g·L−1 initial sodium formate (HCOONa·2H2O) (equivalent to 577 mM formate).

yeast extract.citation: Yeast extract supplies free amino acids, B-vitamins (thiamine, riboflavin, niacin, pantothenate, pyridoxine, folate, biotin, B12), nucleotides and minerals — BD Bionutrient Technical Manual (3rd ed.); Atlas RM, Handbook of Microbiological Media (CRC Press, 4th ed. 2010).

provenance.wellknown_reference: Bertani G. Studies on lysogenesis I. J Bacteriol 1951;62(3):293-300; Sambrook & Russell, Molecular Cloning (CSHL, 2001). LB (Lennox): tryptone 10, yeast extract 5, NaCl 5 g/L; no added sugar.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.

composition_limitation: This record's composition, bounds and quantities are identical to 3 other record(s). The modifier(s) its name declares are not represented in the chemistry and must not be read as a compositional difference.
